annotation.title_clean: Commission Regulation (EU) 2023/2482 of 13 November 2023 amending Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 as regards the substance bis(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate (DEHP) in medical devices
annotation.title_en: Commission Regulation (EU) 2023/2482 of 13 November 2023 amending Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 as regards the substance bis(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate (DEHP) in medical devices
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: Commission Regulation amending REACH Annex XIV to postpone the latest application date (to 1 January 2029) and sunset date (to 1 July 2030) for authorisation of DEHP use in medical devices, aligning with MDR/IVDR transitional periods. Not related to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Latest application date for DEHP in medical devices moved to 1 January 2029
Sunset date for DEHP in medical devices moved to 1 July 2030
Aligned with transitional periods of Regulations (EU) 2017/745 and 2017/746
Motivated by notified body capacity limits and avoiding device shortages
Enters into force the day after publication in the OJ
